title: Quantization signature stability harness for embedding models (INT8/FP16)
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a reusable stability harness that generates deterministic quantization signatures for embedding models (INT8 and FP16 paths), runs calibration and post-quantization validation, and surfaces cosine-similarity drift regressions over time. The goal is to enable safe rollouts of quantized embedding variants into Dedicated and Private deployments by enforcing automated acceptance gates and clear rollback criteria.
acceptance_criteria: Harness can produce a model-level quantization signature file (human-readable JSON) summarizing layer-wise scale distributions, per-dimension dynamic ranges, and sample-wise embedding deltas for both INT8 and FP16 profiles.
Nightly CI job runs calibration across canonical holdout corpora and emits a similarity delta report; alerts trigger when mean cosine drop > 0.007 or 95th-percentile drop > 0.02 compared to baseline.

End-to-end calibration pipeline integrated with quant-calib repo and launches GitHub Actions; artifacts (calibration tables and signatures) are archived to s3://redwood-quant-artifacts/ and linked in job output.
Console dashboard tile shows trend lines for mean cosine, cosine-variance, and sample-level outliers with links to failing prompts and PRs for remediation.
Runbook documented with canary rollout steps, rollback triggers, and manual acceptance flow for model owners.
calibration_plan: Select three canonical corpora: metadata-search-queries (50k), docs-snippets (10k), and customer-chats (5k anonymized).
For each corpus run token-preserving preprocessing to ensure embedding sequence determinism.
Perform per-layer min/max capture with 256-sample sliding windows, generate per-channel scale stats for INT8, and layerwise fp16 residual histograms.
Run calibration script with 8 seeds for random subsampling to measure sampling variance and produce consolidated scale tables.
Store calibration artifacts to S3 path and generate signature file with stable hashing (sha256 of canonical stats).
evaluation_matrix: Metrics: mean cosine similarity (baseline vs quantized), median cosine, 95th-percentile regression, MAP@10 on reranking subset, and downstream retrieval latency increase.
Thresholds: mean cosine drop tolerance 0.005 for low-risk corpora, 0.007 default, 0.01 high-risk; 95th-percentile tolerance 0.02.
Sampling: nightly sample of 10k embeddings stratified by corpus and user cohort, weekly full run for release candidates.
Regression detection: use rolling 30-day baseline with exponential decay weight (alpha=0.1) to handle workload drift.
evaluation_results_summary: Initial FP16 quant path shows median cosine change -0.0022 and mean -0.0031 against baseline on docs-snippets. INT8 path (symmetric per-channel calibration) shows mean -0.0068, 95th percentile -0.018. Small cohort of customer-chats exceeded 95th-percentile threshold prompting follow-up sampling and targeted layer re-calibration.
